facts.text: Deborah started a yoga class in her neighborhood, which she shared with her neighbors.

evidence.quote: I started this yoga class in the neighborhood - it's such a good feeling! Now I get to share the exercise with my neighbors and watch it really transform them.
My neighbors were interested in trying yoga, so I hosted a class for them on Friday.

facts.text: Deborah hosted a yoga class for her neighbors on Friday, which they embraced and enjoyed.

evidence.quote: My neighbors were interested in trying yoga, so I hosted a class for them on Friday. It was great to see everyone embrace and enjoy it.

facts.text: Deborah shared a photo of the yoga class with Jolene, showing a group of women posing for a picture.

evidence.quote: Here is our photo together. [image: a photo of a group of women posing for a picture]

facts.text: Deborah found yoga calming and wanted to share that experience with others to bring them peace and awareness.

evidence.quote: I find it calming and wanted to share that with others. Giving people peace and awareness brings me so much happiness.
